name: Manolo Blahnik
band_note: shoe house, banded on shoe entry $875 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's pumps, mules, sandals and bridal shoes, mostly $1,000–1,500 (Hangisi $1,450), plus bags and men's shoes, sold through its own boutiques, site and department stores.
origin: Founded in London, United Kingdom in 1970 by Manolo Blahnik.

ownership.owner: Manolo Blahnik International Limited (privately owned, family run)

quote.q: Manolo still sketches every shoe himself and works with his niece to bring the collection to fruition.

opview: “Manolo still sketches every shoe himself and works with his niece to bring the collection to fruition.” — Manolo Blahnik (house), The Company, manoloblahnik.com
